text.p: Results of four-day English County Championship cricket matches on Saturday:

At Nottingham (Trent Bridge): Nottinghamshire beat Derbyshire by two wickets. Derbyshire 319 and 117 (M.Bowen 4-34). Nottinghamshire 192 and 248-8 (W.Noon 63, P.Franks 50; D.Malcolm 4-91). Nottinghamshire 20 points, Derbyshire 7.
At Taunton: Yorkshire beat Somerset by 140 runs. Yorkshire 306 and 237-6 declared, Somerset 203-5 declared and 200 (R.Harden 50 not out; P.Hartley 5-34). Yorkshire 21 points, Somerset 5.

At Chester-le-Street: No play first day. Durham v Worcestershire - match drawn. Worcestershire 351-6 declared and 113-8 (M.Saggers 5-57), Durham 132 and 332 (M.Foster 58, D.Boon 57, J.Lewis 52; A.Sherivar 5-54). Durham 5 points, Worcestershire 16.

At Cardiff: Glamorgan v Hampshire - match drawn. Hampshire 309-4 declared with second innings forfeited, Glamorgan forfeited first innings and 287-8 (S.James 76, G.Butcher 58). Glamorgan 4 points, Hampshire 6.

At Birmingham (Edgbaston): No play first day. Warwickshire beat Middlesex by 8 wickets. Middlesex 221 and 132 (M.Ramprakash 50; G.Welch 5-46), Warwickshire 158 and 198-2 (A.Moles 67 not out, N.Smith 60). Warwickshire 20 points, Middlesex 5.

At Leicester: No play first day. Leicestershire v Surrey - match drawn. Surrey 278 and 166-5, Leicestershire 340 (D.Maddy 103, P.Nixon 64 not out, V.Wells 56; C.Lewis 4-64). Leicestershire 10 points, Surrey 9.
At Horsham: Kent beat Sussex by 104 runs. Kent 245 and 440, Sussex 264 and 317 (K.Newell 112, M.Newell 57; M.McCague 7-82). Kent 21 points, Sussex 6.

At Manchester (Old Trafford): Lancashire v Northamptonshire - match drawn. Northamptonshire 479 and 232-6 declared, Lancashire 415-9 declared and 114-0 (J.Gallian 56 not out). Lancashire 6 points, Northamptonshire 7.
At Gloucester: No play first day. Gloucestershire v Essex - match drawn. Gloucestershire 290 and 64-3, Essex 310 (S.Law 84, A.Grayson 81; M.Ilott 4-82). Gloucestershire 9 points, Essex 10.
